description: Short tons and metric tonnes of hot mix for up to three compacted courses over four areas, with a cited in-place unit weight and the spread rate a paving quote is written in. Estimate only; confirm with your plans, supplier and local code.

base.description: Base. Unit: ft (imperial) or m (metric). A number in that unit, or a string that carries its own unit such as "20 ft 6 in". Shown on the site only when "shape=triangle" is set.

priceTon.description: Price per ton. Unit: $ / short ton (imperial) or $ / t (metric). Optional.

role1.description: Layer 1 course. Options: surface = Surface course; binder = Binder course; base = Asphalt base course.

system.description: Unit system the inputs are typed in and the defaults are taken from.
